Fourthly is my mother who walked me through the sleepless nights, the bad grades and severe discouraging moments — she motivated me to achieve the best I can; she worked hard so as to receive education and prayed for me daily. Lastly but not least, I'd want to recognise our school sponsor, ACK Kiu River, which hosted Wednesday mourning [morning] services and also visited us; this played a vital role in forming the person you see before you.
